subject: SOC2 re-attestation + renewal / capacity increase for Orchid Financial
messages:
From: Tanya Ghosh <tanya.ghosh@orchidfinancial.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Jul 2028 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 re-attestation + renewal Qs (Orchid Financial)

Hi Priya / Marissa,

We're approaching our contract renewal window (Aug 31) and we'd like to coordinate SOC 2 re-attestation details so we can complete our internal procurement and legal review. A few items we're trying to pin down:  

- Retention horizon for audit logs: Orchid needs an option for 18 months of immutable retention (our internal policy changed). Can Redwood support 18 months for the audit/log slice?
- Evidence handoff: who will own the evidence index and delivery for the attestation window? We typically need exportable manifests and a CSV index for our auditors.
- Capacity & seats: usage has grown — we're forecasting a 2.5x token throughput increase and want to explore a dedicated capacity uplift + seat increase. What are pricing and lead times?
- If there are SOC 2 scope changes in the last 12 months (new control mappings or vendor changes), please highlight them so our compliance team can decide if a shadow audit is required.

Attached: Orchid_security_questionnaire.zip (contains our security questionnaire and current retention policy).

Can we aim for a short call next week? If it's helpful, loop in Redwood legal for a term amendment draft that covers retention and capacity pricing.

Thanks,
Tanya
Tanya Ghosh
Head of Security Programs | Orchid Financial
T: +1 415 555 0192

---

(attachment stub: orchid_security_questionnaire.zip)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tanya Ghosh <tanya.ghosh@orchidfinancial.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 re-attestation + renewal Qs (Orchid Financial)

Hi Tanya — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the questionnaire. Marissa and I reviewed the top-line items and we can support the timeline for Aug 31 renewal, but there are a couple of details to align on first:  

1) Retention: Redwood can offer an 18-month audit-log retention carveout as an addendum. There are two implementation modes:  (a) managed retention (Redwood stores immutable log snapshots for 18 months) or (b) customer-managed export (we provide scheduled encrypted exports to your S3). Each has different cost implications — I'll attach an initial retention matrix for your review.

2) Evidence handoff: we propose a combined approach: Redwood Compliance will produce an evidence index CSV and a staged artifacts bundle (PDF/CSV) for the attestation window; Orchid's auditor can pull export packages from a secure S3 share we provision. Marissa will lead the evidence packaging cadence.

3) Capacity & seats: Ben will follow up with a capacity uplift proposal. Lead time for dedicated GPU capacity is typically 4–6 weeks for a mid-sized uplift; we can provision temporary burst capacity earlier if you need immediate throughput while we finalize the committed pool.

4) SOC 2 scope changes: short answer — limited. We had a vendor mapping change in Feb 2028 (log transport provider swapped to a FIPS-capable relay) and a minor control mapping update for change management. We'll include a change log and an impact assessment.

Let's do a 30-minute call on Tuesday Jul 18 11:00am PT to run through the retention options and timeline. I'll share a calendar invite.

Attachments: retention-matrix.pdf, orchid_soc2-change-log.xlsx

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Manager, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

(attachment stub: retention-matrix.pdf)
(attachment stub: orchid_soc2-change-log.xlsx)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Tanya Ghosh <tanya.ghosh@orchidfinancial.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Jul 2028 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 re-attestation + renewal Qs (Orchid Financial)

Tanya / Priya — quick technical notes ahead of tomorrow's call:  

- Evidence index format: we will provide a CSV with artifact id, type, source node, time window, SHA256, and an S3 presigned URL. That aligns with most auditor checklists.
- Retention implementation: managed retention will append WORM metadata and store snapshots in our compliance-tier blob store; customer-managed export will deliver hourly exports into your encrypted bucket with lifecycle rules. If Orchid needs log-level immutability for 18 months, managed retention is simpler operationally but incurs a monthly storage + audit handling fee.
- Capacity uplift: For 2.5x throughput we recommend a Dedicated Tier 'D2' pool (mix of A100-equivalent nodes) and a temporary burst pool for the first 4 weeks. Approx lead time: 28 business days to ramp Dedicated and 3 business days for burst. Ben — will you drop a pricing sketch?

On the scope changes: the vendor mapping note is low risk — we use the FIPS relay only for transport and it does not change control ownership. We'll include the mapping docs in the change log.

See you on the call — agenda: retention options + draft term language + capacity sketch + delivery milestones.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
